samples.question: A dark reference glyph is shown in the box at the top of the image. Each glyph is a filled dark disk that contains some number of bright holes: small light regions fully surrounded by the dark ink. The image below is split into four quadrants: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, and bottom-right. Each quadrant holds one dark glyph. Exactly one quadrant's glyph contains the SAME number of enclosed holes as the reference glyph; the other three each contain a different number. Which quadrant contains the glyph whose number of enclosed holes matches the reference glyph? Answer with one quadrant name.
